mission.title: Empowering the Next Generation of Tech Leaders
mission.subtitle: TechLabs is a non-profit organization dedicated to making technology education accessible to everyone, regardless of their background or financial situation.
mission.description: We believe that everyone deserves the opportunity to learn in-demand tech skills and build a career in the digital economy. Through our innovative blended learning approach, we combine online resources with local community support to create a unique learning experience that prepares students for real-world success.

story.hook: In 2018, a group of students in Münster asked a simple question: why does learning tech skills have to cost thousands of euros?
story.body:
They couldn't find a good answer. So they built TechLabs — a volunteer-run program where anyone with motivation could learn web development, data science, or AI, completely free. No entrance exams, no tuition, no income-share agreements. Just a community of people helping each other grow.

What started as a single cohort of 40 learners has become a movement across eight European cities. Over 2,500 Digital Shapers have graduated. The mentors are still volunteers. The program is still free. And the question that started it all still drives everything we do.

quote.text: I'd been rejected from three paid bootcamps I couldn't afford. TechLabs didn't ask for my bank statement — they asked what I wanted to build.
